answer: Farms mint key packs that share one operator clock. A joiner locks 4.25 POA for 11 hours in a standalone anchor vault and posts a 28-byte pigment card (low 24 bits of SHA-256(pubkey||hour-salt||jitter) on a 192-cell grid). The grid then issues three 18-byte puzzles 4 minutes apart; the joiner must echo each with the card and a 6-digit vault nonce. Five established peers recompute the cell and drop any second in-window key within Hamming distance 2. A colliding pigment, a late or wrong echo, or a reused vault slashes 80% and bars that cell for six epochs.
